text:
A lovely night for Hirose and Nakamura!
I'm still trying out a few things.
Admit it, you'd want to be one of Prince Eric's servants! He's one of my favorite princes, who's next?
Now that Bleach has ended, who do you prefer, Grimmjow or Urahara? I already know we all love Ichigo 😉

Goku's Day on Earth is here! Hope you like it.
Goku has arrived on Earth for a day, but Gohan wants to spend as much time with him as possible 😉
Adult Shinra Kusakabe is so handsome! I wonder who's accompanying him.

I love this scene. The way Hidenori Goto moves his toes is so hypnotic 😍
From Samurai Flamenco.

Today is our dear Nakamura's birthday and we haven't planned anything! 😭
So far we've made these stories of him with Hirose!
Light Yagami needs to move fast and distract L, or he's gonna figure out he's Kira.

Marvel didn't just show Hawkeye's feet, they showed Spiderman's too. Just look at that close-up 😍
Someone clearly likes animating the heroes barefoot.

Hey everyone! After a long time, Goku and Gohan are back in a new story.
Goku's Day on Earth is coming this month.
